issue.title: Error reporting does not work if used with native image (graalvm) due to reflection usage in the lib

repository.name: sentry-java
repository.description: A Sentry SDK for Java, Android and other JVM languages.

issue.body:
_Platform:_
- [x] Kotlin -> 1.4.20, graalvm 11
- [x] Logback -> 1.2.3 
- [x] Quarkus.io -> 1.12.1.Final

_Build system:_
- [x]  Gradle -> 6.3

The version of the SDK:
**4.1.0**

---
I have the following issue:

All of our services use sentry.io to report errors. This works nicely for our legacy spring services that do not use graalvm to build native container images. Our latest services use quarkus.io and graalvm though and the reporting does not work for them. Instead of reporting a meaningful error to sentry, the error lacks any content - no stack trace, error message, whatsoever: 

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1176370/110980186-de554d80-8365-11eb-8a03-9787608400a0.png)

If I build any of these quarkus.io services with a traditional image (openjdk-11), the reporting works as expected. In native images it does not work though. 

I also created an error on the quarkus.io github: https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/15623

This issue can be temporarily worked around by providing the sentry classes that need reflection in a reflection-config.json file, which is read by graalvm. IMO this should be fixed in the sentry library though. 

**Steps to reproduce:**
- Provoke an error that will be reported to sentry 
- Ensure that this application runs natively (graalvm)

**Actual result:**
- Unlabelled error with no content (message, stacktrace)

**Expected result:**
- Regular error with content
